title: Citation
description: Represents an in-text citation marker and its parsed bibliographic reference.

id.description: Unique UUID of the citation marker

raw_marker.description: Original in-text citation string as parsed (e.g., '[1]', 'Smith et al., 2020')

marker_type.description: Classification of the in-text citation format

page_number.description: Page on which the citation appears

char_span.description: [start, end] character indices of the citation marker in page text

reference_text.description: Full bibliographic text from the References section linked to this marker

matched_paper_id.description: UUID of the resolved ResearchPaper record
